headline: 3 Utility Stocks Riding Data Center Power Demand
summary: Data centers are racing to keep up with AI demand, yet the real bottleneck is something far less glamorous than chips: electricity. That tension between digital ambition and physical grid constraints is where potential opportunity emerges for investors watching power infrastructure, grid owners, and utilities exposed to this theme. This article walks through three stocks from our screener that sit close to this fault line and explains how the recent news could matter for each one. The three...

headline: NextEra Energy Vs. AES Corporation: Utility Scale Energy Production Just Got a Major Blue Boost
summary: Democrats just took Congress, and clean energy stocks surged. But one utility giant is racing to build batteries for data centers while its rival has already put itself up for sale. Only one of them captured the rally.

headline: Fluence Energy names interim CEO, CFO amid supply chain hiccups
summary: Executives from shareholders Siemens and AES took C-suite roles as Fluence seeks to address supply chain challenges and allegations of securities fraud.

headline: Fluence Energy Stock Drops on Leadership Overhaul
summary: Fluence Energy stock dropped 5.5% after the company said it will replace its CEO, CFO, and institute new oversight of its operations.

headline: AES Corporation Stock Outlook: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
